top_signals.title: Iran Faces a Deepening Natural Gas Crisis Ahead of Winter
top_signals.summary: Iran is heading into winter facing a worsening natural gas shortage, as damage to key processing facilities during the war with the United States and Israel compounds years of chronic supply deficits. President Masud Pezeshkian warned on November 21 that the country would likely face energy supply problems this winter. "Even before this, we were facing an energy imbalance, and now attacks on the country's gas infrastructure have made this imbalance worse. We expect to face problems in the winter," Pezeshkian said. top_signals.title: Battlefield Power Is Running Short
top_signals.summary:
Drones, counter-drone systems, electronic warfare, and edge computing all run on power. Soldiers need more of it, in more places, farther from their supply lines than ever before. How will the Army get it to them? Alex Miller (U.S. Army), Ben Kesling (Chariot Defense), Julie Bush (Valinor Enterprises), and Joel Dillon (Booz Allen) join the show. They discuss moving power to the edge, managing the signatures it creates, and the push for common power standards across the services. They also explore how software can help commanders manage energy like ammunition, and what a well-run battalion’s approach to power might look
